content: Neural abstractive summarization models have also been explored to summarize longer documents. Word extraction models have been previously explored, performing worse than sentence extraction models BIBREF19 . Hierarchical attention-based recurrent neural networks have also been applied to the task, owing to the idea that there are multiple sentences in a document BIBREF15 . Finally, distraction-based models were proposed to enable models to traverse the text content and grasp the overall meaning BIBREF4 . The current state-of-the-art performance is achieved by a graph-based attentional neural model, considering the key factors of document summarization such as saliency, fluency and novelty BIBREF14 .
